title: Warm Cheesy Malaysian Kippers Casserole
description: A savory and cozy Malaysian dish featuring kippers, shio-cure, and a blend of cheeses, perfect for a comforting dinner. This recipe is onion and garlic free, making it suitable for those with dietary restrictions.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large saucepan, combine the milk, shio-cure, and butter, and heat over medium heat until the butter has melted.
In a large bowl, combine the kippers, cheddar cheese, parmesan cheese, salt, and black pepper.
Add the milk mixture to the kipper mixture and stir until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake for 25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is heated through.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve hot and enjoy the cheesy, savory goodness.
